decisions.decision: Snapshot the working files with a temp copy of the index after the command
decisions.why: Checks run before commit; the user index stays untouched
decisions.rejected: HEAD only, or git stash create which skips untracked files

decisions.decision: Changed files = tracked diff against the tree plus untracked files the tree lacks, excluding specs and .specify
decisions.why: A diff against a tree misses new files
decisions.rejected: Building a fresh tree on every panel refresh

decisions.decision: Verified turns amber on a stale check; the header strip stays as is
decisions.why: The section holds the row; the strip counts checks

decisions.decision: Freshness compares the check snapshot with a fresh snapshot of now, built from a copy of the real index
decisions.why: A read-tree index has no timestamps, so git re-read all 2,914 files in 3.3 s; the copy takes 0.18 s
decisions.rejected: Diffing the working tree against a read-tree scratch index

decisions.decision: The snapshot is taken before the command runs
decisions.why: A change made during a long check must make it stale, not current

decisions.decision: Results are reused for 5 s and in-flight checks are shared
decisions.why: The panel refreshes on every record write during a run
decisions.rejected: A git round on every refresh
